name: Bressal

attributes.attribute: an alternate spelling of the name Bresal

text: Bressal is an alternate spelling of the name Bresal. The two forms point at the same well-known Irish name. That name was carried by several kings and a saint of the early land. A reader who meets Bressal should turn to the entry on Bresal for the fuller account of its many bearers.

okr.objective: Note that Bressal is a variant form of the name Bresal.
key_results: Bressal and Bresal name the same figure.
The fuller account sits under the spelling Bresal.
